operations.description:
Lists approval requests associated with a project, folder, or organization.
Approval requests can be filtered by state (pending, active, dismissed).
The order is reverse chronological.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] accessapproval projects approval requests list [PATH] v 1beta 1 approval requests [PARAMS] access alt callback fields filter key oauth page parent pretty print protocol quota size token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] access approval approve decision dismiss list locations properties reason request requests resource response

operations.description:
Updates the settings associated with a project, folder, or organization.
Settings to update are determined by the value of field_mask.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] accessapproval projects update access approval settings [PATH] v 1beta 1 [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key mask name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type update upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] access approval enrolled service settings

operations.description:
Approves a request and returns the updated ApprovalRequest.

Returns NOT_FOUND if the request does not exist. Returns
FAILED_PRECONDITION if the request exists but is not in a pending state.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] accessapproval projects approval requests approve [PATH] v 1beta 1 name approve [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] access approval approve decision dismiss locations message properties reason request resource

operations.description:
Dismisses a request. Returns the updated ApprovalRequest.

NOTE: This does not deny access to the resource if another request has been
made and approved. It is equivalent in effect to ignoring the request
altogether.

Returns NOT_FOUND if the request does not exist.

Returns FAILED_PRECONDITION if the request exists but is not in a pending
state.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] accessapproval projects approval requests dismiss [PATH] v 1beta 1 name dismiss [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] access approval approve decision dismiss locations message properties reason request resource
